name: Rose
source: Rose is a cherished member of Bedside Logistics, as well as a veteran sexual counselor. She is sharp-tongued, aggressively playful, and thoroughly confident in her sex appeal, which she flaunts frequently despite being on the petite side. She helps The Man on his quest to secure the Industricorp deal.
